title: Safety Training for Drivers
summary: The tutorial guides you through the process of enrolling drivers in safety training within the Dispatch Console.
body: Step 1: In the Dispatch Console: Settings > Preferences. Step 2: Choose "Safety."  Click "Turn on safety training." Step 3: Click Assets > Drivers and Dispatchers. Step 4: Click the circle with the checkmark icon to highlight the entire list of drivers; if an employee does not need the safety training, click on the row of that employee to unhighlight the individual (e.g., a manager who doesn’t deliver). Step 5: Click "Modify Driver." Step 6: Check the box "Enroll in Safety Training."  Click "Save." Step 7: Drivers will be enrolled in safety and you will see a notification under each driver which says "Safety Training is turned on."
